scope: Read-only current platform/admin source and deploy configuration logging inventory; no production mutation

checks.result: direct source inspection; initial guessed filenames corrected using rg --files

checks.command: docker run --rm --network none --platform linux/amd64 --entrypoint sha256sum crefans-api:dashboard-20261022 <7 listed source files>; compare hashlib SHA256
checks.type: local copy of deployed image verified against source

present.events: DB platform_operational_events plus Telegram outbox, IP/peer/request_id/time/type/allowed target IDs/status, delivery attempt/error fields
present.errors: HTTP>=500, worker and post-bootstrap process fatal events; error type and allowlisted internal code, not message/stack
present.security: selected API query SQL signatures, detection per10min window, second hit blocks24h, next request after expiry records release; blocked repeats not individually recorded
present.worker: each run in platform_jobs with duration/activity/failures; activity/errors immediate Telegram, hourly idle summary
present.admin: inquiry reply/report resolution/document save actor+target events; financial_policy_changes version/new values/actor/reason/time
present.finance: checkout current status/attempts/failure/retry/approval/subscription ID; revenue ledger; not complete append-only attempts history

gaps: No admin log search/list/detail API or screen; only undelivered count, last worker check, finance policy history/payment states
No comprehensive HTTP access log: Caddy lacks log directive, no API success/4xx request completion logging
No error stack/code line/release fingerprint and no authenticated actor in general error context
request_id persisted internally but not returned to user, not printed in Telegram message; limited request/job/payment linkage
Login success/failure/logout/permission rejection and sensitive data reads lack durable audit event coverage
Some admin events in delivery outbox deleted after30 days when sent; no before/after document/profile snapshot
Payment/refund/payout attempt timeline and original sanitized provider cause not durably preserved; several failures generalized PAYMENT_FAILED
No central off-host log sink or immutable/archive policy in checked deployment; Docker per-container10m*3 rotation and local MySQL share host
No client browser error collector or independent whole-host/DB-startup/OOM monitor configured in checked scope
SMTP sendMail result/message ID not persisted by MemberMailService

retention.deliveredOperationalEvents: created_at older than30days deleted by worker including admin events
retention.financialPolicyHistory: no automatic TTL found in reviewed code
retention.docker: json-file max-size10m max-file3 each service, capacity not guaranteed days

limits: No new product tests run because no product code changed
No fresh remote raw DB/log sweep; current source and last verified deployment evidence only
No legal retention policy determined; retention periods require separate scoped decision
No Telegram/email sent, no SSH/firewall changes

officialSources.applied: who/what/when/where, interaction linking, administrative actions, protected/redacted logs and retention
per-container stdout/stderr, max-size/max-file rotation and oldest file removal
log directive enables HTTP access logs; runtime output alone does not imply access logging
